summary: Verified the auto-seed of the Myntra 500 campaign end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass against the preview public URL (health, GET /api/campaigns, GET /api/campaigns/7701ea79/prospects with pagination + status filter, POST retry-failed, no _id leakage, seed idempotency). Also simulated the production fresh-DB scenario by running seed_myntra_campaign() against a temp DB: campaign created + exactly 91 prospects imported, all 'pending', 0 empty names, and re-running the seed created no duplicates. Frontend: logged into /linkedin-search with the agent password, opened the CRM Campaigns tab - Myntra 500 card renders with 91 total / 91 pending / 0 sent / 0 failed, progress bar, and Show Prospects expands a table with 50 rows containing name, brand, title, status and working LinkedIn links (verified https://in.linkedin.com/in/anirudh-mohan-ab9b907). Collapse works, Send Batch button enabled. No console errors, no error elements.

minor.issue: Template omits 'attachment_path'. The preview campaign doc has attachment_path=/app/backend/uploads/fundle_marketplace_brochure.pdf, so a freshly seeded production campaign will differ from preview (field absent). Current send flow does not read attachment_path, so impact is data-parity only - but add it to the template for consistency.
Unknown campaign_id returns 200 with total=0 instead of 404; harmless but hides typos.
No campaign existence check - returns success/reset=0 for any non-existent campaign_id.
Seed is fired as a fire-and-forget asyncio task at startup with errors only logged; a failed seed is silent (no health/status surface to detect it in production).

integration_issues.issue: Prospect table is capped at limit=50 with no pagination or 'showing 50 of 91' indicator, so 41 seeded prospects are unreachable from the UI.
fetchCampaigns/fetchProspects only console.error on failure - no visible error state; a backend outage renders an empty 'No campaigns yet' state that is indistinguishable from a real empty DB.
POST /api/campaigns/{id}/retry-failed has no UI trigger; the 'failed' stat is not clickable, so users cannot retry from the CRM.

issues: Progress bar track is fully invisible at 0% sent (same tone as border) - consider a subtle fill or percentage label
'Show Prospects' toggle uses #a1a1aa on #18181b at 12px - low prominence for the primary expand control

action_items: Add 'attachment_path': '/app/backend/uploads/fundle_marketplace_brochure.pdf' (or a relative path) to MYNTRA_CAMPAIGN_TEMPLATE so production parity is kept
Add pagination / total indicator to the prospects table (only 50 of 91 visible)
Add error/empty-state distinction and a Retry Failed control in CampaignsView
critical_code_review_comments: seed_myntra_campaign duplicates ~30 lines of the row-parsing logic in import_prospects_from_xlsx - extract a shared _import_prospects(campaign_id, xlsx_path) helper (DRY).
Excel column indexes (row[0], row[16], row[17], row[21]) and min_row=5 are magic numbers duplicated in two places; a header change silently imports blank names.

Module-level Motor client uses os.environ.get('MONGO_URL', '') with an empty default - fail fast instead (empty URI raises an opaque pymongo ConfigurationError, which I hit when importing the module outside the server process).
seed_data_creation: Temp Mongo DB 'TEST_seed_sim_db' created to simulate a fresh production seed and dropped afterwards. NOTE: the requested retry-failed test reset the 25 previously-failed preview prospects back to 'pending' (campaign now 91 pending / 0 failed) - this is expected endpoint behaviour, not a bug.
test_credentials: Agent password Agent@2024! on /linkedin-search (works). /app/memory/test_credentials.md lists vineetnarangofc@gmail.com / InvoiceAgent@2024! for admin API auth (not needed - campaign endpoints are unauthenticated).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Campaign endpoints in routes/campaign_manager.py require no auth, so they can be hit directly with requests. Reusable suite at /app/backend/tests/test_myntra_seed.py (run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_myntra_seed.py -v). /app/backend/tests/sim_fresh_seed.py reproduces the production fresh-DB seed safely in a temp DB (must set DB_NAME before importing routes.campaign_manager because the Motor client is module-level). Send-batch was NOT exercised (would send real LinkedIn messages via Voyager and consume the 25/day limit).
rca_of_the_issue: Original production issue (missing Myntra contacts) is resolved: seed_myntra_campaign runs at startup, checks for campaign_id 7701ea79, and imports from the code-deployed /app/backend/uploads/prospects.xlsx. Fresh-DB simulation confirms 91 prospects imported and idempotency on repeat runs (per-prospect public_id dedupe plus the campaign-exists early return). Remaining gap: attachment_path is not part of the seed template, so production will lack the brochure path present in preview.
